title: Banking Transaction Risk
description: Rule-based risk flags on accepted synthetic banking transactions.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(transactions), 0) as "Transactions" from analytics.daily_risk where $__timeFilter(day_utc)
select coalesce(sum(flagged_transactions), 0) as "Flagged" from analytics.daily_risk where $__timeFilter(day_utc)
select coalesce(round(100.0 * sum(flagged_transactions) / nullif(sum(transactions), 0), 2), 0) as "Flag rate" from analytics.daily_risk where $__timeFilter(day_utc)
select day_utc as "time", transactions as "Accepted", flagged_transactions as "Flagged" from analytics.daily_risk where $__timeFilter(day_utc) order by day_utc

select account_id as "Account", transactions as "Transactions", flagged_transactions as "Flagged", velocity_flagged_transactions as "Velocity flagged", avg_risk_score as "Average score", late_transactions as "Late", flagged_amount as "Flagged amount", last_seen_at as "Last seen" from analytics.account_risk where flagged_transactions > 0 order by avg_risk_score desc, flagged_amount desc, account_id limit 20

panels.title: Kafka backlog by partition

targets.rawSql: select measured_at as "time", lag, kafka_topic || '/' || kafka_partition::text as metric from ingest.kafka_lag where $__timeFilter(measured_at) order by measured_at

panels.description: Kafka end offset minus the next offset committed to PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Processing delay (p95, ms)

targets.rawSql: select processed_at as "time", p95_processing_delay_ms as "Batch p95" from ingest.stream_batches where $__timeFilter(processed_at) order by processed_at

panels.description: 95th percentile of the time from Kafka timestamp to the database write, per batch.

panels.title: Rejected and late transactions

targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('minute', processed_at) as "time", sum(rejected_records) as "Rejected", sum(late_records) as "Late for velocity" from ingest.stream_batches where $__timeFilter(processed_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Late valid transactions retain their amount and overnight risk scores.

panels.title: Pipeline failures and database retries

targets.rawSql: select ts as "time", sum(failures) as "Failures", sum(retries) as "Database retries" from (select date_trunc('minute', occurred_at) as ts, count(*) as failures, 0 as retries from ingest.stream_errors where $__timeFilter(occurred_at) group by 1 union all select date_trunc('minute', processed_at), 0, sum(db_retries) from ingest.stream_batches where $__timeFilter(processed_at) group by 1) events group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Errors logged to PostgreSQL and transient write retries recorded when a batch succeeds.
